title: BioIVT Precision MHFASTED moves from MH to SC (Subject Characteristics)
description: Moves MHFASTED ('Did the donor fast overnight >= 8 hours?') from Medical History to Subject Characteristics on Precision. Fasting status is a protocol-defined testing condition, not a history item.
rationale: CDASH Subject Characteristics (SC) domain documentation defines a dedicated 'protocol defined condition' variable with FASTING as its own named example: "Confirmation that the protocol defined condition imposed on the subject when testing (e.g., FASTING, HYDRATION, EXERCISE) was met." Verified against CDASH SC domain documentation before writing this (2026-09-28), not asserted from general domain knowledge alone. Precision already has an SC form with a matching yn choice list, so no new form was needed for this one -- unlike the DOD/TOD/COD case in the same audit. ARCHIVED 2026-10-04: the source used to justify SC was misattributed (page titled 'CDASH Subject Characteristics' but its content was lab-collection metadata). The only CDASH fasting variable verified is LBFAST (LB domain). Precision's PC form already collects fasting (BLDFAST, CSFFAST) on the same visits as MH, so MHFASTED is likely a duplicate; resolution pending Dan's decision in the domain-alignment audit.
source: CDASH Subject Characteristics domain documentation; domain-alignment audit, BioIVT Option C project

history.note: First use of the new move_to_form directive. Detroit has no equivalent field -- this is Precision-only.
Reverted the move: SC placement not supported by a verified CDASH source; field likely duplicates PC.BLDFAST/CSFFAST.
